turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I was uh, wondering what I could help you with today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah hi, um, I have been coughing nonstop for the past three days, and today I have been feeling very short of breath. So I just wanted to get it all checked out.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, for sure. And, so you said the cough started uh, three days ago. Were there any triggers to the cough or anything that, uh that changed three days ago?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing that I can think of um, I have, like the only thing that I've been doing is going to the grocery stores, uh the bank, and laundromat. Um, and once I ran all these errands, like, I just started having this coughing fit that hasn't stopped.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, uh, has the cough gotten any better, or stayed the same, or gotten worse these past three days?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, it seems like it's getting worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, are you bringing up any uh, sputum or phlegm?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um yes, it's yellow.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, is this um, any different from before? Like have you had a cough in the past and, and brought up phlegm, or is this entirely new for you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um no, this has happened to me before, um, like I don't know, like maybe a year or two years back. Uh, and it kind of feels the same, but just a little bit worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Um, and uh, have you seen any blood in the sputum?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no blood.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Um, and you mentioned you've been short of breath as well. Uh, how has that come on?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, it was, I, I don't know if it's because of all the coughing that I've been doing, but it just started this morning.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, um, and have you been experiencing uh shortness of breath um, on exertion otherwise, like prior to this?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um no, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. And have you had any shortness of breath after, like if you lie down flat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no, not that I've noticed

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: All right, and have you had a wheeze?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: A little bit, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay um, uh, and have you had any um, infectious-like symptoms such as like red eyes, runny nose, or, or a sore throat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, um, have you had any, any chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had any lightheadedness or, or feeling dizzy?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Or feeling like your heart's racing or, or beating really fast?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. And, um, have you had any fevers or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I've noticed.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had any night sweats?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And how has your weight been over the last several months? Have you had any weight loss or gain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, it's been pretty stable.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Um, and have you had any abdominal pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any diarrhea?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Or any urinary problems?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Um, and in the past um, oh sorry, before that, have you had any nausea or, or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Uh, and any confusion or, or changes to um, um memory?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, uh, or loss of taste or sense of smell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay uh, so the, you've been experiencing this cough that's been getting worse over the last couple of days, as well as bringing up some yellow sputum, um, and been short of breath. Have you been experiencing any other symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, that's pretty much it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Um, and in the past, have you um, been diagnosed with any medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I have diabetes, I have high blood pressure and I have high cholesterol.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see. Alright, and do you take uh, medications for those things?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, so I am on ramipril for the high blood pressure, rosuvastatin for the cholesterol, and insulin for the diabetes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, thank you. And uh, you mentioned you had a similar episode in the past. Um, what, uh, were you diagnosed with COPD before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I was, I was diagnosed with COPD about five years back.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, did you have pulmonary function tests for this? The test where you had to breathe into a tube.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um yeah, I had that done like five years ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, um, alright um, just wanted to see if it was uh like formally diagnosed. Sometimes people uh, um, yeah, it's important to have that, uh, those tests done. Um, and do you have any allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no none. None, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Um, and uh, are your immunizations up to date?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, I believe so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, um and have you had any surgeries or, or um, hospitalizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I had my Gallbladder removed when I was in my 50s. Um, and I had a hip fracture three years ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and how is your mobility now?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um pretty good. My hips still give me some issues once in awhile, but um, for the most part, it's been okay.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, that's good. It sounds like the rehab went well.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And uh, right now, can you tell me um, a little bit about your living situation? Like where you're living and who you're living with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I live by myself in an apartment on the 1st floor.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, um and, do you smoke cigarettes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, I quit two years ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and that's, that's great. Um, prior to that, how long did you smoke for, and how much?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh, for like 40-plus years um, I used to smoke a pack a day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, well that's great that uh, that you quit, so congratulations.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I drink once in a while. Like maybe every other day, I'll have a glass of wine.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and um, uh anybody, or sorry, have you been around anybody who's been sick recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You said you went to the stores and stuff like that.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, maybe from there, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and have you traveled anywhere else, outside of the city?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, not recently, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, um, and any exposures to any like dust, chemicals, things like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I live in an old building so maybe. Um, but it hasn't bugged me before.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, uh, and are you working currently or, or retired?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I'm retired.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, well, what did you do before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I used to work uh, on the assembly line for Chrysler.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, were there any exposures uh, there that you were aware of, like things that you were breathing in?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh not that I was aware of, but they were always like smoke and fumes and things like that because it was like a factory, so maybe.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Right, okay, that makes sense. Um, and in the family, are there, anybody who, who's had problems with their hearts or lungs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, my mom had lung cancer when she was 50. And, like, all the, like diabetes, hypertension and high cholesterol runs on my, ran on my father's side of the family.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, did anybody have uh, heart attacks or, or stroke?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yeah, so my father had a heart attack when he was 49. Uh, stroke I'm not too sure about.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, thank you. And, um, so that was all I wanted to ask about. Um, was there anything else that you wanted to add that I maybe forgot?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no, that's about it, but I, how can I treat myself now? How do I make this cough go away?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: For sure, so, um, we will first get your vitals here and we'll see if your oxygen levels um, are low, then it would be important to put on some oxygen first, um, just to make sure that that's stable. Um, and from there we will um, get a chest x-ray um, and uh, run some lab work to, to try to help figure out the, the diagnosis better, but in the meantime, we'll use um, some inhalers because it's possible that this is a COPD exacerbation similar to uh last year, um, and the inhalers should help open up the airways and dilate, so make breathing easier, and then um, also if it is a COPD exacerbation, it will likely require antibiotics, as well as some steroids for the, the inflammation for five days. Uh, but since your symptoms currently overlap with uh, COVID as well, you'll have to get a, a COVID nasal swab.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay, okay for sure.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, so uh, we'll get that started.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay. Thank you so much.
